basis: ten genuine V4.64 matches, 1600 action slots

scenes.name: 跃起躲铲
scenes.condition: 带球者先拨走球，防守者朝球路方向横身滑铲；带球者跃过后继续控球，人物造型不画脚
scenes.result: 避过本次滑铲并重新控球

actionOutcomeState.scope: action settlement before scoring-round transition; goal settlement may already include mandatory restart

scenes.name: 双触横拨突破
scenes.condition: 防守者位于正前方相邻格；持球者先拨向一侧诱使其跟随，再从另一侧穿过对手所在格，最终进入其身后一格
scenes.result: 横拨避开下脚，进入防守者侧后方

actionOutcomeState.scope: action settlement before scoring-round transition; goal settlement may already include mandatory restart

scenes.name: 牛尾巴变向
scenes.condition: 正面迎击且球可先向一侧引动再扣回
scenes.result: 球连续反向，避开本次迎击

actionOutcomeState.scope: action settlement before scoring-round transition; goal settlement may already include mandatory restart

scenes.name: 急停扣回摆脱
scenes.condition: 双方位于同一纵深、并排向前；持球者突然刹停扣回一格，防守者继续冲过
scenes.result: 先制动再反向带离，保住球权
phases: 持球人急停，防守者继续冲

actionOutcomeState.scope: action settlement before scoring-round transition; goal settlement may already include mandatory restart

scenes.name: 回旋护球摆脱
scenes.condition: 防守者留在原格作为回旋中心；持球者从其一侧绕半圈到另一侧，球始终在外侧
scenes.result: 护球回旋，从接触另一侧带离

actionOutcomeState.scope: action settlement before scoring-round transition; goal settlement may already include mandatory restart

scenes.name: 弧线绕过封线
scenes.condition: 实际弧线传球成功，直线会穿过对手格而实际球路绕开
scenes.result: 绕开真实封线，完成传接

actionOutcomeState.scope: action settlement before scoring-round transition; goal settlement may already include mandatory restart

scenes.name: 受压一脚穿线
scenes.condition: 前一脚传给受压队友，该队友下一行动直接将球传给第三人，实际两脚均传成

actionOutcomeState.scope: action settlement before scoring-round transition; goal settlement may already include mandatory restart

scenes.name: 挑传越过上抢者
scenes.condition: 防守者实际位于球路中间，挑球高度越过其头顶，同队接应者控制球
scenes.result: 挑传越过上抢者并接球

actionOutcomeState.scope: action settlement before scoring-round transition; goal settlement may already include mandatory restart

scenes.name: 穿透防线的直塞
scenes.condition: 队友朝正前、左前或右前空当跑；直线地滚球穿过一名防守者所在格，他伸脚未勾到
scenes.result: 直线地滚球穿过防守者一格，伸脚未勾到，同队前插者接球

actionOutcomeState.scope: action settlement before scoring-round transition; goal settlement may already include mandatory restart

scenes.name: 抢先切断穿透球
scenes.condition: 防守者由球路外切入实际经过格，提前断球并在该格控制；近端长传弹球不标为抢断控制
scenes.result: 防守者先用身体碰到球，将球拨向侧方，随后追上并在拦截格控制；此次不是松球

actionOutcomeState.scope: action settlement before scoring-round transition; goal settlement may already include mandatory restart
